cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to show you how to set up a repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 講師：現在示範如何設定重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: This is for a one-way, repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這是單因子重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: So one-factor with repeated measures.
cues.zh: 也就是一個因子，具有重複量測。

cues.en: We still have to use a slightly different setup of the code for a two-way ANOVA, a factorial ANOVA.
cues.zh: 雙因子或因子設計 ANOVA，仍需要稍微不同的程式安排。

cues.en: And I will cover that in a later video.
cues.zh: 後面的影片會說明。

cues.en: So the previous video you learned about one-way ANOVA for independent samples.
cues.zh: 上一支影片學到獨立樣本的單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: And now we are doing a one-way ANOVA for repeated measurements.
cues.zh: 現在則做重複量測的單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm gonna start by simulating data.
cues.zh: 先模擬資料。

cues.en: And this is a really similar way to how I simulated the data in the previous video.
cues.zh: 方法與上一支影片模擬資料的方式非常相似。

cues.en: The only difference, there's one small code difference and then there's a conceptual difference.
cues.zh: 只有一個小小的程式差異，以及一個概念上的差異。

cues.en: The code difference is that we only have one sample size parameter here.
cues.zh: 程式差異是，這裡只有一個樣本大小參數。

cues.en: And that makes sense because it has to be the same across all of the groups, all the levels within the factor, because these are repeated measures.
cues.zh: 這很合理，因為是重複量測，各組、因子內所有水準的樣本數必須相同。

cues.en: And otherwise the way that I simulate the data is the same.
cues.zh: 其他模擬資料的方式相同。

cues.en: The conceptual difference is that we are now thinking about these three datasets as being three different levels, three different groups
cues.zh: 概念差異是，現在把這三份資料集，看成三個不同水準、三個不同群組，

cues.en: that are all measured within the same individual.
cues.zh: 全部都是在同一批個體內量測。

cues.en: Now of course, that's just a kind of weird assumption that I'm putting on top of how the data are actually generated because they're generated as independent Gaussian processes.
cues.zh: 當然，這是額外套用在資料上的一個有點奇怪的假設，因為實際上是用獨立高斯過程產生資料。

cues.en: But we're thinking about these as being coupled data.
cues.zh: 但我們把它們看成配對資料。

cues.en: So they're all measured from the same individuals.
cues.zh: 全部來自相同個體。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So I told you in the previous video that there's a slightly different way that we have to set up the data for the repeated measures ANOVA
cues.zh: 上一支影片提到，重複量測 ANOVA 的資料安排方式，

cues.en: versus the non repeated measures independent samples, one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 與非重複量測、獨立樣本的單因子 ANOVA 稍有不同。

cues.en: So what we do here is create what's called a table.
cues.zh: 這裡建立所謂的 table。

cues.en: This is a MATLAB variable type that I haven't yet introduced you to.
cues.zh: 這是尚未介紹過的 MATLAB 變數型別。

cues.en: So let me show you what this table looks like.
cues.zh: 示範 table 的樣子。

cues.en: So here we have a table of data.
cues.zh: 這是一張資料表。

cues.en: Now it looks like a matrix at first.
cues.zh: 乍看像矩陣。

cues.en: So it's three columns and we have a bunch of rows corresponding to the different individuals.
cues.zh: 有三欄，以及對應不同個體的許多列。

cues.en: But you can see it doesn't look exactly like a matrix.
cues.zh: 但可以看出，與矩陣不完全相同。

cues.en: It is a type data. So this is a different data type.
cues.zh: 這是不同的資料型別。

cues.en: And here we have the labels of each column.
cues.zh: 這裡有每欄的標籤。

cues.en: So because these are just meaningless variable name this doesn't actually come from any real experiment.
cues.zh: 因為只是沒有意義的變數名稱，不來自真實實驗，

cues.en: So I called these variables qwerty, DrX and purple.
cues.zh: 所以把變數叫作 qwerty、DrX 與 purple。

cues.en: Of course, you're welcome to rename these as you see fit.
cues.zh: 當然可以依需要重新命名。

cues.en: Okay, so we need a table for the data and then we need another table for all of the variables that get grouped together.
cues.zh: 需要一張資料表，另外還需要一張表，列出要分在一起的所有變數。

cues.en: So that's what you see this table here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡這張表。

cues.en: So this is still a table, but this is a table of strings and it's kind of arbitrary.
cues.zh: 仍是 table，但內容是字串，名稱有點任意。

cues.en: And we just say that these are the three levels that we have.
cues.zh: 只表示這是我們的三個水準。

cues.en: Now, we could have also called these qwerty, DrX and purple, but I just gave them different names here just to simplify things and show you that we don't actually need to preserve these same names.
cues.zh: 也可以叫 qwerty、DrX 與 purple，但我給了不同名稱，簡化說明，也讓你知道不必維持相同名稱。

cues.en: This is the label that gets used.
cues.zh: 這是之後使用的標籤。

cues.en: This column title is what gets used later on.
cues.zh: 這個欄名之後會用到。

cues.en: Okay, so now we have our two tables.
cues.zh: 現在有兩張表。

cues.en: We have a table that contains all the data and we have a table which contains the repeated factor.
cues.zh: 一張包含全部資料，一張包含重複量測因子。

cues.en: So this is what we're gonna use to tell MATLAB later on that this is repeated across the different individuals.
cues.zh: 稍後用它告訴 MATLAB，這是在各個個體內重複量測的。

cues.en: So now previously we could use a function called ANOVA one.
cues.zh: 先前可以用 anova1 函式。

cues.en: And as I mentioned in the beginning of the previous video, that function is a simplified function that works only for independent samples, one-factor ANOVA.
cues.zh: 上一支影片開頭提過，它是簡化函式，只適用於獨立樣本、單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: So the way that this works here for more complicated models is we first use a function called fitrm for repeated measures.
cues.zh: 更複雜模型的做法，是先使用 fitrm 函式，rm 表示重複量測。

cues.en: That's the rm that's going to give us this model here.
cues.zh: 它會產生這裡的模型。

cues.en: And then we're actually going to run the model using the function ranova for repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 接著用 ranova 函式執行模型，代表重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: So it's a kind of a weird looking line of code.
cues.zh: 這一行看起來有點奇怪。

cues.en: So let me walk you through it.
cues.zh: 一步步說明。

cues.en: So first we input the table of data.
cues.zh: 首先輸入資料表。

cues.en: That's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: The next input is actually the design of the statistical model.
cues.zh: 下一個輸入，其實是統計模型的設計。

cues.en: And the way that we specify a model for a repeated measures ANOVA is that we model the data as an intercept.
cues.zh: 指定重複量測 ANOVA 模型的方式，是把資料建模為截距。

cues.en: So we say these are the variables we want qwerty through purple so that's also gonna include DrX.
cues.zh: 指定要用的變數從 qwerty 到 purple，也包含 DrX。

cues.en: So it's these three variables.
cues.zh: 也就是這三個變數。

cues.en: That's what we get with this hyphen here.
cues.zh: 這個連字號就表示這個範圍。

cues.en: So the variables from qwerty through purple are modeled as an intercept.
cues.zh: 從 qwerty 到 purple 的變數，建模為截距。

cues.en: Now the reason why we model it as an intercept with a number one, is that we don't have separate columns in the dataset in the table for the dependent variable
cues.zh: 用數字 1 表示截距，是因為資料表中，沒有為依變數

cues.en: and the independent variable.
cues.zh: 與自變數分別設置欄。

cues.en: And that's because the dependent variable is just all the numbers and the different columns correspond to the independent variable.
cues.zh: 依變數就是所有數字，而不同欄對應自變數。

cues.en: Okay, and then because this is a within subjects design, so repeated measures designed, then we input this table that we specified here
cues.zh: 因為這是受試者內設計，也就是重複量測設計，所以輸入先前指定的這張表，

cues.en: to indicate that all of three of these columns all come from the same factor, which is levels.
cues.zh: 表示這三欄全部來自同一個因子，叫作 levels。

cues.en: Okay, and then so that creates this model output and we can see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 這會建立模型輸出，可以看看內容。

cues.en: It's mostly just a lot of information that we're not going to interpret directly.
cues.zh: 大部分只是大量資訊，不會直接解讀。

cues.en: Instead, we are going to use this as a model to fit here in the ANOVA.
cues.zh: 我們會把它作為這裡 ANOVA 要擬合的模型。

cues.en: So we specify this is the repeated measures table or repeated measures model.
cues.zh: 指定這是重複量測表，或重複量測模型。

cues.en: And then we have to specify that the within subjects factor is levels.
cues.zh: 接著指定受試者內因子是 levels。

cues.en: And that's what we created up here.
cues.zh: 也就是上面建立的。

cues.en: Now without this, MATLAB is not going to know which factor is repeated.
cues.zh: 沒有這個，MATLAB 就不知道哪個因子是重複的。

cues.en: And so we'll assume that the factors are in fact independent, which is not what we want.
cues.zh: 就會假設因子其實彼此獨立，那不是我們要的。

cues.en: Okay, so that gives us our ANOVA, oops, our ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 得到 ANOVA，哎呀，是 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: And now this table looks kind of familiar.
cues.zh: 這張表看起來有點熟悉。

cues.en: So we still have the summer squares degrees of freedom means squared in the F statistic and the P-value.
cues.zh: 仍有平方和、自由度、均方、F 統計量與 P 值。

cues.en: But the row labels are a little bit different and possibly a little bit confusing.
cues.zh: 但列標籤稍有不同，可能有點容易混淆。

cues.en: So first of all, we have an intercept.
cues.zh: 首先有截距。

cues.en: MATLAB is including the intercept here, testing the intercept.
cues.zh: MATLAB 在這裡納入並檢驗截距。

cues.en: Now this is something I mentioned at the very beginning of this section when I first introduced the ANOVA, that ANOVA models can also include an intercept,
cues.zh: 本單元最初介紹 ANOVA 時提過，ANOVA 模型也可以包含截距，

cues.en: which basically just tests the null hypothesis that the mean, the average value of all the data is zero.
cues.zh: 基本上檢驗所有資料平均值為 0 的虛無假設。

cues.en: So we've created these data to have mean greater than zero because we shifted all these numbers.
cues.zh: 我們建立的資料平均值大於 0，因為把這些數字都平移了。

cues.en: So we find that the intercept term has a huge F-value and the P-value is tiny.
cues.zh: 所以截距項的 F 值很大，P 值很小。

cues.en: Now this is not terribly interesting and it's not something we need to interpret.
cues.zh: 這並不特別有趣，也不需要解讀。

cues.en: This is just telling us that the average across all the data values is significantly different from zero.
cues.zh: 只是告訴我們，所有資料值的平均值與 0 有顯著差異。

cues.en: So usually you just ignore the intercept term in the ANOVA table, okay?
cues.zh: 所以通常忽略 ANOVA 表的截距項。

cues.en: But here we have the levels and this is actually what we want.
cues.zh: 但這裡有 levels，這才是真正要的。

cues.en: So this is the levels factor.
cues.zh: 這是 levels 因子。

cues.en: And here we can see that the, let's see the F statistic is 16.2 and that is also highly significant.
cues.zh: 可以看到，F 統計量是 16.2，同樣高度顯著。

cues.en: So this is telling us that we have a significant effect of the factor, which here I called levels.
cues.zh: 表示這個我稱為 levels 的因子，有顯著效果。

cues.en: These other P-values here are for various corrections if those are necessary like greenhouse geyser correction, but I'm not talking about those in this video.
cues.zh: 其他 P 值適用於必要時的各種校正，例如 Greenhouse–Geisser 校正，但這支影片不討論。

cues.en: Okay, so you can see that setting up the ANOVA is a little bit more complicated than how it works for the more simple version of the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 因此，設定 ANOVA，比簡單版本的單因子 ANOVA 稍微複雜。

cues.en: But it's not so bad if you're when you're applying this to your own data, just try to follow this pattern and it will work out.
cues.zh: 但不會太難。套用到自己的資料時，試著遵循這個模式，就能成功。

cues.en: So I found from a little bit of Googling I found on the SPSS website.
cues.zh: 我稍微用 Google 搜尋，在 SPSS 網站找到資料。

cues.en: SPSS is a statistical software package that they have a simple data set with all integer that they make available on their website here
cues.zh: SPSS 是統計軟體套件，它們在這個網站提供一份全部都是整數的簡單資料集，

cues.en: and they show you how to run this model in SPSS, but it's essentially the same thing that we are doing here.
cues.zh: 也示範如何在 SPSS 執行這個模型，但基本上與我們這裡做的相同。

cues.en: So it's a one-way repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 就是單因子重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: So I thought it would be interesting just to copy their data and run through the same model in MATLAB and then you can check if you're curious
cues.zh: 我覺得把資料複製過來，在 MATLAB 執行相同模型會很有意思；如果好奇，可以檢查，

cues.en: that the output you get from MATLAB here matches exactly what you would see on this website.
cues.zh: 這裡 MATLAB 的輸出，是否與網站上看到的完全一致。

cues.en: So there's nothing new in the code here compared to what I showed in the previous cell, but I thought it would be nice number one to have a second example and number two to be able
cues.zh: 與上一個儲存格相比，這裡的程式碼沒有新東西，但提供第二個例子很不錯，而且也能

cues.en: to compare this against the SPSS output online.
cues.zh: 與網站上的 SPSS 輸出比較。

cues.en: So I'm going to simulate data here in a really similar way to how I simulated data in the previous video on the one sample
cues.zh: 這裡模擬資料的方式，與上一支單樣本，

cues.en: or one way ANOVA with independent samples.
cues.zh: 或者說獨立樣本單因子 ANOVA 影片，非常相似。

cues.en: And you can see that the means are in fact the same.
cues.zh: 可以看到，平均值其實相同。

cues.en: So I just copied and pasted a lot of this code.
cues.zh: 很多程式碼直接複製貼上。

cues.en: There's really only kind of two differences.
cues.zh: 實際上只有兩個差異。

cues.en: One coding difference and one more conceptual difference from how we did this in the previous video.
cues.zh: 一個程式差異，一個概念差異，與上一支影片不同。

cues.en: So the coding difference is that previously we had three different ends, one n for each group.
cues.zh: 程式差異是，先前有三個不同 N，每個群組各一個。

cues.en: And here I'm specifying the the global end to be 30.
cues.zh: 這裡指定整體 N 為 30。

cues.en: And that's because we are assuming that this is a repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 因為假設是重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: And so therefore every individual has to be measured three times.
cues.zh: 每個個體都必須量測三次。

cues.en: So there's in fact only one sample size here.
cues.zh: 所以實際上只有一個樣本大小。

cues.en: And so that's the coding difference.
cues.zh: 這就是程式差異。

cues.en: The conceptual difference is basically what I just said, that we are assuming that these data all come from the same individuals that were measured three times, which is it's kind of different bit
cues.zh: 概念差異，基本上就是剛才說的，假設資料全來自同一批個體，每個人量測三次；這和這裡產生數字的方式，

cues.en: off from how I simulate the numbers here, which is as independent random Gaussian processes.
cues.zh: 也就是獨立隨機高斯過程，有一點不同。

cues.en: So I'm still going to convert these data into a pandas dataframe and that's what I do here.
cues.zh: 仍然會把資料轉成 Pandas DataFrame，這裡就是如此。

cues.en: The main difference between how I'm doing it here and in the previous video with the one independent samples one-way ANOVA is that here I'm gonna have each column
cues.zh: 與上一支獨立樣本單因子 ANOVA 影片的主要差異，是這裡每一欄

cues.en: correspond to a level or group, whereas in the previous video I had one long vector with a separate column to indicate the group membership.
cues.zh: 對應一個水準或群組，而上一支影片是一條長向量，另外用一欄表示群組歸屬。

cues.en: So we can see what that looks like here.
cues.zh: 可以看看這裡的樣子。

cues.en: So this is data one, data two, data three.
cues.zh: 這是 data one、data two、data three。

cues.en: You can think of this as measurement one, measurement two, measurement three.
cues.zh: 可以想成第一次、第二次、第三次量測。

cues.en: And the rows correspond to individuals.
cues.zh: 各列對應個體。

cues.en: So this is individual number eight.
cues.zh: 這是第 8 號個體。

cues.en: This is the ninth individual in our dataset.
cues.zh: 它是資料集中的第 9 位個體。

cues.en: And this is the measurement on dimension one, dimension two, and dimension three.
cues.zh: 這是第一、第二與第三個維度的量測。

cues.en: Okay, so now to implement the repeated measures ANOVA, I'm again using this module Penguin.
cues.zh: 為了實作重複量測 ANOVA，再次使用 Pingouin 模組。

cues.en: We use the function rm in ANOVA, which of course stands for repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 使用 rm_anova 函式，當然代表重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: And now I'm requesting in the a more detailed version of the table, you can see the default is set to false.
cues.zh: 現在要求表格較詳細的版本，可以看到預設是 False。

cues.en: And that was this compact version that we saw in the previous video.
cues.zh: 那就是上一支影片看到的精簡版。

cues.en: So we said detailed to be true, and it's not a whole lot more detailed to be honest, but we do get a more complete table than what we saw in the previous video.
cues.zh: 把 detailed 設為 True，老實說沒有詳細太多，但確實比上一支影片有更完整的表格。

cues.en: So in this case, the F statistic is 16, so that's highly significant.
cues.zh: 這裡 F 統計量是 16，所以高度顯著。

cues.en: P is much less than 0.05.
cues.zh: P 遠小於 0.05。

cues.en: So we can say that there is a significant difference in this ANOVA between these three groups here.
cues.zh: 因此可以說，這個 ANOVA 中，三個群組之間有顯著差異。

cues.en: Okay, and then again, we can make a box plot to help us visualize what's going on here and not so surprising because this is how we specified how the data should be simulated.
cues.zh: 同樣可以畫盒形圖，幫助視覺化這裡的情況；並不意外，因為模擬時就是這樣指定資料的。

cues.en: Okay, so then, I did a little bit of Googling and I found this example on the SPSS website.
cues.zh: 接著，我稍微用 Google 搜尋，在 SPSS 網站找到這個例子。

cues.en: If you haven't heard of SPSS, it is a statistics analysis package.
cues.zh: 如果沒聽過 SPSS，它是一個統計分析套件。

cues.en: So they have an interesting tutorial there where they make all the data available on this website and then they do a repeated measures ANOVA,
cues.zh: 有個有趣教學，網站上提供全部資料，再執行重複量測 ANOVA，

cues.en: which I then just reproduced here using Pandas and Penguin.
cues.zh: 我在這裡用 Pandas 與 Pingouin 重現。

cues.en: And I just thought it'd be interesting not partly to see another example and also partly to see, to compare this to the output of SPSS,
cues.zh: 覺得這很有意思，一部分是再看一個例子，另一部分是能比較 SPSS 的輸出，

cues.en: which you can get from this website.
cues.zh: 網站上就能取得。
